title: Extract DML insert/update/delete/returning/constraints modules
problem: dml.rs combined primary-key targeting helpers, INSERT/UPSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, RETURNING projection, and constraint/default helpers.
approach: Keep shared primary-key targeting helpers in mod.rs.

Run cargo check --lib and focused insert/update/delete/returning integration tests.
